newsitem.title: UK: UK shares track Wall Street reluctantly higher.
newsitem.headline: UK shares track Wall Street reluctantly higher.

text.p: The British stock market ended Tuesday on a firm note as an unexpected rise on Wall Street dragged share prices higher, dealers said.

The FTSE 100 share index, which spent much of the day becalmed around 3,960 points on worries about next week's budget and interest rates, tracked the U.S. market reluctantly higher to close at 3,978.1, up 16 points on the day.

As London closed, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up by more than half a percent at 6,381 points, bolstered by a rise in bond prices after weaker-than-expected U.S. housing starts data for October.
